events.author: rrnBQwtV95mqysLXxmpZgHEsWNSAfyX_05SRH0Dbymg
events.body:
Parent issue: #241

mplement the BLT-Next Worker backend integration with the existing BLT authentication API.

Scope

Review the existing authentication API contract.

Implement signup and login API integration.

Implement logout and session validation.

Handle API responses and errors correctly.

Use secure session cookies with appropriate security attributes.

Avoid exposing session tokens to frontend JavaScript.

Acceptance Criteria

Signup and login requests integrate with the supported BLT API endpoints.

Logout invalidates or clears the session appropriately.

Session validation works correctly.

API errors are handled safely.

Session cookies use appropriate security settings.

Backend authentication tests are included.

Notes

Verify the actual BLT API endpoints and request/response formats before implementation. Do not assume undocumented API behavior or introduce a separate account system.
